PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
The optical fiber transceiver realizes the conversion between Ethernet twisted pair and Ethernet optical signal, and the maximum network transmission distance can be increased to more than 100km. The product series supports link fault alarm, wide operating temperature range, port and power surge protection, and meets deployment requirements in outdoor monitoring environments such as rail transit, safe city, and intelligent transportation.
